paired_effect.reason: Use contrast_analyses for the two prespecified contrasts; calibration is descriptive only

multiplicity.calibration_note: Calibration exposes descriptive arm intervals and paired point changes only; causal co-primary intervals require the separate fresh main collection.
multiplicity.interpretation: Two prespecified two-sided contrast intervals use alpha/2 each. Familywise coverage is approximately the requested level for percentile bootstrap intervals, conditional on their marginal coverage; Bonferroni does not require independent contrasts.

reporting_scope: Eight repetitions including a budget-limited extension after interim inspection; exploratory extension
spend_note: Resolved results only. Add billed superseded attempts from the controller ledger before reconciling total project spend. Amounts tagged cost_is_upper_bound include conservative unsettled reservations, not exact billed usage. Top-level spend counts each supplied resolved run once; do not sum contrast-level spend because their baseline records are shared.
